items: UPS sets $10.70 Protected Delivery fee. UPS will offer Protected Delivery at $10.70 per shipment starting Nov. 16, according to its website. On its earnings call, UPS said it expects U.S. daily volume up about 25% from Q3 to Q4 but slightly lower year over year because of reduced Amazon deliveries.

UPS Ship API EU PID fields not live. UPS's developer guide had said the Product Identifier fields were in Ship API production. It now says they are "not yet available" there, with final production timing to come later.

Blue Dart launches India-to-US parcel service. International Parcel Connect, powered by DHL eCommerce, launched Oct. 26 for eligible B2C parcels of 50 grams to 11 kilograms, with Standard or Expedited delivery. Blue Dart plans to extend it to the UK, EU, Canada and Australia, and no pricing was stated.
